subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly Manila to Yinchuan via Guangzhou on China Southern Airlines for a week in Ningxia. You will see the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, a winery, Zhenbeipu Western Film Studio, Helan Mountain Rock Art, the Three-Lake Traverse and Tengger Desert, Shapotou and the Yellow River Grand Canyon. Hotels are 4-star plus one night at a desert hotel.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Apr 9–15 2027 to Jun 25–Jul 1 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Western Xia Imperial Tombs: A large burial complex of the Western Xia dynasty emperors near Yinchuan, known as the Pyramids of the East.
placeDesc.COFCO Great Wall Talent Winery: A winery in Ningxia's wine region, with a tasting of two wines included on the visit.
placeDesc.Lanshan Park: A Yinchuan park known for its Roman-style architecture, photographed at sunset.
placeDesc.Zhenbeipu Western Film Studio: A film set of old Chinese frontier scenery near Yinchuan, used for many well-known movies.
placeDesc.Helan Mountain Rock Art: Ancient rock carvings on Helan Mountain, reached on this tour with an electric cart.
placeDesc.Huaiyuan Night Market: A busy Yinchuan evening market with local street food and snacks.
placeDesc.Wulan Lake: A desert lake in the Ningxia desert area, crossed on the Three-Lake Traverse by off-road vehicle.
placeDesc.Three-Lake Traverse: An off-road desert drive through the Tengger Desert's lakes, with four travellers per vehicle.
placeDesc.Tengger Desert: A large desert area in northern China, visited with an overnight stay at a desert resort.
placeDesc.Shapotou: A scenic area on the edge of the Tengger Desert beside the Yellow River, with dunes and a glass bridge.
placeDesc.Yellow River Grand Canyon: A scenic gorge of the Yellow River in Ningxia, explored on a boat tour.
placeDesc.108 Pagodas: A stepped group of 108 Buddhist pagodas on a hillside beside the Yellow River in Qingtongxia.
placeDesc.Najiahu Grand Mosque: A large mosque in Wuzhong's Najiahu village, a centre of Ningxia's Hui Muslim culture.
placeDesc.Shuidonggou: A well-known Paleolithic archaeological site near Yinchuan with a scenic area and real-scene experience.
